scopeLimits: API integration evidence is sufficient to record this case as FAIL because a required401/403 response was observed as400. This review makes no browser/UI, full-CU or passing-acceptance claim.
Financial preservation covers the12 named financial tables. It does not claim every Auth, audit, session, refresh-token or other database table was immutable.

Normal local Auth logins, new sessions, refresh/session cleanup, last-sign-in metadata and Auth audit entries are expected authentication side effects. These are distinct from forbidden financial mutations.

Recovery expiry was created by aging recovery_sent_at in the isolated local fixture beyond the resolved3600-second TTL. This is not a one-hour real-wait test; the access-JWT expiry proof did use actual elapsed time.
Expired access plus its own revoked refresh is rejected. An expired access token with a valid refresh token may legitimately renew its session.

Anti-enumeration compares the actual status and complete error-response bytes for one existing identity and one random absent identity. Timing, broader population and production behavior are not established.
Recovery links were generated locally without email delivery. SMTP, external provider, payment, deployment and production behavior are outside this evidence.
